levels.name: Ad hoc
levels.summary: Individuals experiment. Nothing is shared, measured, or repeatable.

levels.name: Exploring
levels.summary: Pockets of deliberate use. Early guardrails, no operating model.

levels.name: Repeatable
levels.summary: Agreed practices and tooling. Outcomes are inspected, not yet trusted.

levels.name: Integrated
levels.summary: AI work is part of the delivery system, with its own controls and metrics.

levels.name: Native
levels.summary: The operating model assumes AI. Removing it would change how the org works.

dimensions.name: Strategy & governance
dimensions.summary: Who decides where AI is used, and who is accountable when it goes wrong.
cells: Policy enforced in the delivery path

dimensions.name: Data & context
dimensions.summary: What the systems are allowed to see, and how good that context is.
cells: Ad hoc access to some sources

dimensions.name: Tooling & platform
dimensions.summary: The shared substrate teams build on rather than each assembling their own.
cells: Platform is on the paved road

dimensions.name: Engineering practice
dimensions.summary: How AI shows up in day-to-day design, review, and delivery.
cells: Agents run inside CI and on-call
Work is designed for agents from the start

dimensions.name: Evaluation & assurance
dimensions.summary: How the organisation knows the output is good enough to ship.

dimensions.name: People & skills
dimensions.summary: Whether capability is concentrated in enthusiasts or held by the team.
cells: Practice is taught, measured, and refreshed
